fields.help: JSON array of {aggregation, field, include_empty, separate_by, custom_separator}. aggregation: append, average, concatenate, count, count_unique, max, min, sum. Results are named <aggregation>_<field> (e.g. sum_amount, unique_count_id, appended_tags). separate_by applies to concatenate (default ','; 'other' uses custom_separator).
fields.label: Fields To Summarize (JSON)

fields.help: Comma-separated fields to group the summary by.
fields.label: Fields To Split By

fields.help: separate_items: one item per group. single_item: one item with groups nested by their values.
fields.label: Output Format

fields.help: Treat field names literally instead of as parent.child paths.
fields.label: Disable Dot Notation

fields.help: Leave out items whose group-by field is empty.
fields.label: Skip Items Without Group Value

outputs.description: one key per fields_to_summarize entry, named by aggregation prefix + field (appended_, average_, concatenated_, count_, unique_count_, max_, min_, sum_)
separate_items: the group's value of each split-by field; single_item: one nested object per group value instead
